EntryData.description:
One entry. Keys are field api_codes (a field with an api_code_alias is keyed by the alias), plus these system keys:
`token`, `serial_number`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `creator_name` (submitter's name), `color_mark` (color mark),
`info_filling_duration` (time spent filling in, seconds), `info_platform`, `info_os`, `info_browser`, `info_region` (`{country, province, city}`), `info_remote_ip`,
and, depending on the form's features, `gen_code` (confirmation code), `total_price` / `preferential_price` (when there are goods), `x_field_weixin_*` (WeChat info), `referral_link` and others.
Exam / evaluation questions also add `<api_code>_extra_value: { correct_answer, score }`; reverse association fields add `<api_code>_entries`, and association fields add `<api_code>_related_entries`.

Value shape by field type:
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Single-line / multi-line text, name, mobile, email, phone, website, ID card | String |
| Single choice, drop-down, image single choice | Choice label (string) |
| Multiple choice, image multiple choice | Array of choice labels |
| Cascading drop-down | `{"level_1": "...", "level_2": "..."}` |
| Number, rating, NPS, formula | Number (a rating may be a string) |
| Yes/No | Boolean |
| Date | Beijing time (UTC+8) string formatted to the field's precision, e.g. `2021-09-23` |
| Time | `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS` |
| File upload | Array of download URLs (signed, valid for 10 years) |
| E-signature | Download URL string |
| Audio | `{"url": "...", "audio_text": "..."}` |
| Address | `{"province","city","district","street"}` |
| Geolocation | `{"longitude","latitude","address"}` |
| Goods | `[{"name","number","price","original_price","inventory","layout","spec"?}]` |
| Matrix fill-in / matrix scale | `[{"statement": "statement label", "dimensions": {"column name": value}}]` |
| Matrix single choice | `[{"statement": "statement label", "choice": "choice label"}]` (the multiple-choice style has a `choices` array) |
| Table | `[{"column name": value}]` (one object per row, empty values omitted) |
| Inline blanks | `{"<sub-field api_code>": "..."}` |
| Ranking | `[{"rank": 1, "choice": "choice label"}]` |
| Reservation | `[{"item_name","scheduled_label","number", ...}]` |
| Form association | Display value string of the associated entry |
| Association (table) | Array of serial numbers of the linked entries in the associated table, e.g. `[1, 3]`; plus `<api_code>_related_entries`: `[{"serial_number": 1, "value": "..."}]`, where value is that entry's first-column value |
When the request has `include_labels=true`, form field values are wrapped as `{label, value}`.

EntryInput.description:
Field values for writing an entry, keyed by field api_code or api_code_alias. Unknown keys and non-writable fields (signature, formula) are ignored.
Choice fields take the choice api_code or the choice label; see the table below for cascading drop-downs and choice extra text. Number fields accept a number or a numeric string.

| Field | How to write |
|---|---|
| Single-line / multi-line text, name, mobile, email, phone, website, ID card | String |
| Single choice, drop-down | `"choice api_code"` or `"choice label"`; extra text via `"<api_code>_extended_text": {"<choice>": "extra text"}`, "Other" text via `"<api_code>_other": "..."` |
| Multiple choice | Array, items as above |
| Image single choice / image multiple choice | Choice api_code (string / array) |
| Cascading drop-down | `{"level_1": "...", "level_2": "..."}` (api_code or label) |
| Number, rating, NPS | Number |
| Yes/No | Boolean |
| Date | `"2012-12-25"` or `"2012-12-25 12:13:15"` (Beijing time, UTC+8) |
| Time | `{"hour": "12", "minute": "15"}` |
| Address | `{"province","city","district","street"}` |
| Geolocation | `{"longitude","latitude","address"}` |
| File upload (multiple allowed) | Array; each item is one of: the id of an uploaded attachment; the download URL of an attachment already on this form (to keep it); `{"base64": "...", "file_name": "a.png", "content_type": "image/png"}` (≤ 5MB; `base64` may also be a data URI) |
| Goods | `[{"value": "goods item api_code", "number": 2, "specification": {"spec dimension": "option"}?}]` |
| Matrix fill-in / matrix scale | `{"<statement api_code>": {"<column api_code>": value}}` |
| Matrix single choice | `{"<statement api_code>": "choice api_code"}` |
| Table | `[{"<column api_code>": value}, ...]`; attachment columns are written like file upload |
| Inline blanks | `{"<sub-field api_code>": "..."}` |
| Ranking | Ordered array `["choice api_code", ...]` |
| Form association | token / id of the associated entry, or a display value matched by the association key (an array for multiple association keys) |
| Reservation | `[{"api_code": "item", "scheduled_at": "2021-04-26", "end_at"?: "...", "number": 1}]` |
| Color mark | `"color_mark": "<color api_code or name>"` |
| International mobile number | Also pass `"<api_code>_country_id"` / `"<api_code>_country_code"` |
